title: 010 再爆装备011 第一
content_zh:
010 再爆装备
三生祝大家中秋快乐！
忽然他快步靠近三人，该出手时就出手，不管愿不愿意，一旦决定就不能犹豫不决，当断不断，必受其乱，只能快刀斩乱麻！
关雨的快步靠近一下子就引起三人的注意，他们顿时大惊，然后大叫起来。
不过他们大叫的内容却让关雨大吃一惊，随即转身就跑，他没有丝毫犹豫。
因为三个老外喊道：噢，上帝！！比利，索罗斯，还不开枪！！！
这话他们是用英语喊的，好在关雨不是张警，他英语还不错所以一下子就听明白他们叫喊的意思。
简单来说那就是——有埋伏！
而且对方手上有枪！
关雨此时紧咬着牙快速的跑，忽然枪声响起，不过并没有击中他，却让他的速度又快了不少，一下子就跑进了小巷之中。
三个老外不远处，两个持枪男子看到这一幕立即向关雨逃跑的方向追去，也进入了小巷之中。
关雨此时快速的奔跑，心脏跳的极快，说实话虽然他已经适应了杀人，但却并没有适应斗争。
简单来说，他能够做到杀人面不改色，却不能够面对持枪或者持刀的人还面不改色。
尤其是对方手里有枪，只要被打中的话，基本上算是完蛋了。
跑了大概五分钟，关雨在一个转角处停下，不断的喘气，然后他侧耳倾听，立即确定对方追来了！
“两个老外是什么人？”关雨心里还有一个疑惑，很显然那两个开枪的老外不是警察，那么为什么要攻击他？
转身进入另外一条小巷，借着月色关雨轻步小跑，然后进入一栋楼房之中。
坐在转角处，关雨微微喘息，渐渐将不安的心冷静下来。
关雨回忆之前的情况，很显然这两个人是事先埋伏在这条路段，可以肯定对方是早有预谋，而且他准备下手的三个猎物事先知道。
至于对方为什么一开始没开枪，恐怕是因为低调勋章的作用。

思前虑后，关雨觉得有三种可能性，第一种是老外自发组织的保卫行动，目的就是保护在城市内的老外安全。第二种可能性就是佐汉通风报信，告诉了有势力的老外，从而引发自己被埋伏，毕竟佐汉恐怕已经怀疑自己，从而想要报复。第三种则是自己杀了什么人，引起某些组织的注意，从而引起这次杀劫。
“还好有低调勋章，不然这次凶多吉少。”关雨心里暗暗侥幸，同时心里警醒自己，以后不能再犯这样的错误。
开始上楼，关雨忽然听到车声，如果只是一般的车声，他绝对不会在意，但这次车声很大，他估计最少来了四辆面包车，从声音大概可以听出，这四辆面包车是一起的，从刹车声就知道他们来的很急。
快速上楼，在楼梯转弯处有窗口，透过窗口看向声音传来的方向，关雨立即看到车头灯的光，他眯了眯眼，只见几个老外从面包车里面下来，个个手里都有手枪。
显然对方的帮手来了。
“擦，全都有手枪，怎么打。”关雨看了都抓狂了，自己手里的武器，除了弓箭是远程之外就只有十把飞刀还算得上是远程攻击，但对方手里用的是枪啊，他又不是李小龙，怎么可能打得过。
他现在唯一称得上是优势的只有三点，第一就是存在感低，便于藏匿，第二点就是力气够大，一个人的力气顶的上两个人，第三就是他在暗处，而这些老外却在他的监视之下。
不过对方的优势也极为明显，手里握着强力武器，只要一枪打中要害就足以让他Gameover！
“只能利用地形了！”关雨想来想去，只有利用地形才有一线生机。
幸好他白天的时候有在这一带走走，熟悉地形，这里的楼房比较密集，靠近高档住宅区，不过小巷特别的多，利用的好干掉一两个人的机会还是有的。
而且对方并不是警察，估计也不敢乱开枪，就像刚刚也只是一人开了一枪，后头都没有再开枪。
既然决定反击，关雨立即开始快步上到楼顶，然后悄悄的观察这些人的位置，这些人居然用手电筒，在黑夜里太醒目了。
当然关雨也知道对方使用手电筒实际上是加大自身的优势，毕竟他们手里有枪，只要发现他就可以来上一枪。
不过对方是怎么知道他没有枪呢？
此时整个小区都是老外在搜索，忽然关雨听到脚步声，有人在上来。
关雨立即轻步走到楼梯口边缘，手里握着唐刀，只要对方一出来他就立即干掉他们。
先是手电筒的光从楼梯内照射出来，对方很小心。
关雨悄悄的挪退一点，立即看到两个老外出来，其中一个老外眼睛正好看着他。
“扑哧！”关雨速度极快，瞬间直接用刀刺穿着老外的脑袋，一瞬间两个老外的脑袋被串了起来。
幸好他们不是专业人员，如果他们一前一后出来或者楼梯内有第三个老外，关雨绝对凶多吉少。

看着倒下的两个老外，其中一个老外的枪口已经指向他，只不过没来得及开枪，刚刚绝对是千钧一发。
先将两人的手枪捡起来，关雨忽然发现地上居然多了两件装备，装备掉落之后是会散发着淡淡的光芒，极为显眼，关雨此时不得不感叹，运气不错，这装备绝对是雪中送炭。
第一件是一张符纸，关雨捡起来就看到属性，传送符，需用知道姓名和ID，关雨看到这里就大概猜测到张警是怎么逃跑，同时心里暗暗警惕，这传送符用的好绝对可怕，将来玩家与玩家之间，要是一旦敌对，绝对不能让他知道姓名和ID，不然千里追杀绝对不是开玩笑的。
将传送符放到背包，拿起第二件装备，居然是一枚戒指。
————————
孤狼之影（戒指）
级别：F+
+15点敏捷
+10夜视
备注：你就如同黑夜中的孤狼，隐藏在黑暗之中随时给予敌人致命一击！
狼牙影套装效果：
（1/2）：+20点敏捷
————————
关雨暗道幸运，立即戴上戒指，这个戒指绝对是他现在最需要的装备之一。
刚刚戴上戒指，关雨就感觉四周变得明亮起来，同时感觉身体轻了不少。
他本身的敏捷是12点，加上15点敏捷也就是27点，这绝对是变态的属性。
要知道他跑步速度其实并不慢，在学校举办的校运会还夺得过短跑以及长跑的一二名，此时加一倍的话，恐怕就算目前跑的最快的运动员都只能在他背后吃尘！
个老外显然是外国国籍，现在只剩下一个目标！
正好需要试验一下孤狼之影的效果，关雨决定干掉这些胆敢暗算自己的人。
他越过两人准备下楼，忽然其中一具尸体手机响起，关雨想了一下拾起手机，按下接听的按钮。

电话对方说的是英语，叽里呱啦的说了一通，但接着他显然觉得不对劲，于是一个劲的问，要关雨回答。
“你们做好死的准备了吗？”关雨想了想，用沙哑的声音说道，然后直接将手机扔在地上，一刀划过，他的速度快了很多，一瞬间手机就被劈开两半。
刚刚他就从电话另外一头的老外那听到了一个人名，哈根！
哈根这个名字，关雨是第二次听到，第一次是从佐汉的嘴里，哈根是一个人名，也是一个组织！
哈根组织，以哈根为中心的一个犯罪组织，因为相当低调，做事滴水不漏，在燕海市有一定的势力，虽然不如本土的势力强大，却也不弱。
关雨不知道自己哪里得罪了哈根组织的人，不过既然他们敢招惹自己，那就要做好遭到报复的准备！
此时他是信心大增，因为他发现自己的神经反应速度都一起加快，也就是说敏捷加的是身体的整体敏捷，而不光是增加速度。
一般人如果摔下楼梯，肯定是滚葫芦一样一滚到底，因为神经反应速度来不及。而如果是关雨的话，现在他就可以及时反应过来，做出高难度的动作防止自己摔伤。
同时他眼睛也变得敏锐，例如一般人是看不到子弹射来的痕迹，但此时如果是关雨的话，却可以看到，并且避开。
不过他能避开的子弹是有先提条件，比如枪离他只有五十米，那就是子弹射出来的时候，距离他如果还有70%以上的射程，那么他就可以避开，一旦超过70%的话，他就不一定能够避开，因为子弹离的太近，速度太快，他的速度就未必够了。
下楼之后，关雨首先看了看四周，确定小巷没有人才出去，现在他的夜视能力+10，刚刚看不清楚的地方都能够看到，就如同白天一样。
不过夜视能力+10，关雨不太清楚+10是什么意思，这个10究竟是距离还是明亮度或者是其他的什么？
走出小巷，关雨将唐刀收入背包，手里握着手枪，一点一点的前进。
他很仔细的听声音，虽然他实力大增，但他本身就是那种谨小慎微的人，自然不会自大的认为自己已经无敌。
忽然灯光照射在他前面的道路上，关雨立即知道有人来了。
content_en:
010 Re-explosion equipment
Sansheng wishes everyone a happy Mid-Autumn Festival!
Suddenly, he quickly approached the three of them and took action when it was time to take action. Regardless of whether he wanted to or not, once he made a decision, he could not hesitate.
Guan Yu's quick approach immediately caught the attention of the three people. They were shocked and then yelled.
However, the content of their shouting surprised Guan Yu, and he turned around and ran away without any hesitation.
Because three foreigners shouted: Oh, God! ! Billy, Soros, don't shoot yet! ! !
They shouted this in English. Fortunately, Guan Yu was not Zhang Jing. His English was not bad, so he understood the meaning of their shouts at once.
To put it simply, there is an ambush!
And the other party has a gun!
Guan Yu clenched his teeth and ran quickly. Suddenly a gunshot rang out, but it did not hit him, but it made him run a lot faster, and he ran into the alley.
Not far away from the three foreigners, two men with guns saw this scene and immediately chased in the direction where Guan Yu escaped, and also entered the alley.
Guan Yu was running quickly at this time, his heart beating extremely fast. To be honest, although he had adapted to killing, he was not adapted to fighting.
To put it simply, he can kill people without changing his expression, but he cannot face people with guns or knives without changing his expression.
Especially if the opponent has a gun in his hand, as long as he is hit, he is basically dead.
After running for about five minutes, Guan Yu stopped at a corner, panting continuously, and then he listened carefully and immediately confirmed that the other party was chasing him!
"Who are the two foreigners?" Guan Yu still had a doubt in his mind. Obviously the two foreigners who fired the shots were not policemen, so why did they attack him?
Turning around and entering another alley, Guan Yu trotted lightly under the moonlight, and then entered a building.
Sitting at the corner, Guan Yu panted slightly, gradually calming down his uneasy heart.
Guan Yu recalled the previous situation. It was obvious that the two men had ambushed this section of the road in advance. It was certain that the other party had planned it in advance, and the three prey he was planning to attack knew about it in advance.
As for why the other party didn't fire at the beginning, it was probably because of the low-key medal.
After thinking about it, Guan Yu felt that there were three possibilities. The first was a security operation organized by foreigners voluntarily, with the purpose of protecting the safety of foreigners in the city. The second possibility is that Zohan tipped off the information and told it to a powerful foreigner, which caused him to be ambushed. After all, Zohan may have doubted himself and wanted revenge. The third type is that he killed someone and attracted the attention of some organizations, thus triggering this killing.
"Fortunately, I have a low-key medal, otherwise this time it would have been a disaster." Guan Yu was secretly lucky, and at the same time, he warned himself that he would not make such a mistake again in the future.
As he started to go upstairs, Guan Yu suddenly heard the sound of a car. If it was just an ordinary car sound, he would never care. But this time the sound of the car was very loud. He estimated that at least four vans were coming. From the sound, he could probably tell that these four vans were together. From the sound of the brakes, he knew that they were coming in a hurry.
Quickly going upstairs, there was a window at the turn of the stairs. Looking through the window towards the direction of the sound, Guan Yu immediately saw the light of the headlights. He squinted and saw several foreigners getting out of the van, each with a pistol in his hand.
Apparently the other party's help has arrived.
"Damn, they all have pistols, how can we fight." Guan Yu went crazy after seeing it. Apart from the long-range bow and arrow, the only weapons in his hand were ten throwing knives, which could be considered long-range attacks, but the opponent was using a gun. He was not Bruce Lee, how could he possibly beat him.
The only thing he has that can be called an advantage now is three points. The first is that he has a low sense of presence and is easy to hide. The second is that he is strong enough. One person can be stronger than two people. The third is that he is in the dark, but these foreigners are behind him.Under surveillance.
However, the opponent's advantage is also extremely obvious. He holds a powerful weapon in his hand. As long as one shot hits the vital point, it is enough to make him Gameover!
"We can only use the terrain!" Guan Yu thought about it and figured out that only by using the terrain could he have a chance of survival.
Fortunately, he had walked around this area during the day and was familiar with the terrain. The buildings here were relatively dense and close to high-end residential areas, but there were many alleys. If he used them well, there was still a chance to kill one or two people.
Moreover, the other party was not a policeman, so he probably did not dare to shoot randomly. Just like just now, one person only fired once, and no more shots were fired afterward.
Now that he decided to fight back, Guan Yu immediately started to quickly climb to the top of the building, and then quietly observed the positions of these people. These people actually used flashlights, which were too conspicuous in the dark night.
Of course, Guan Yu also knew that the opponent's use of a flashlight actually increased his own advantage. After all, they had guns in their hands and could shoot him as soon as they spotted him.
But how did the other party know that he didn't have a gun?
At this time, foreigners were searching the entire community. Suddenly Guan Yu heard footsteps and someone was coming up.
Guan Yu immediately walked lightly to the edge of the stairs, holding Tang Dao in his hand. As soon as the other party came out, he would kill them immediately.
First, the light of the flashlight shone from the stairs, and the other party was very careful.
Guan Yu quietly moved away a little, and immediately saw two foreigners coming out, and one of them just looked at him.
"Pu Chi!" Guan Yu was very fast and instantly stabbed the foreigner's head with a knife. In an instant, the two foreigners' heads were strung together.
Fortunately, they were not professionals. If they came out one after another or there was a third foreigner in the stairs, Guan Yu would definitely be in trouble.
Looking at the two fallen foreigners, one of them had his gun pointed at him, but he didn't have time to shoot. It was definitely a critical moment.
After picking up the pistols of the two men, Guan Yu suddenly discovered that there were two more pieces of equipment on the ground. After the equipment was dropped, it would emit a faint light, which was very conspicuous. Guan Yu had to sigh at this time, he was lucky, this equipment was definitely a timely help.
The first item was a piece of paper talisman. When Guan Yu picked it up, he saw the attribute, the teleportation talisman, which required the user to know the name and ID. When Guan Yu saw this, he roughly guessed how Zhang Jing escaped. At the same time, he was secretly wary. This teleportation talisman would be absolutely terrifying if used well. In the future, if there is hostility between the player and the player, he must not be allowed to know his name and ID, otherwise chasing him thousands of miles away is definitely not a joke.
Put the teleportation talisman in the backpack and pick up the second piece of equipment, which turned out to be a ring.
————————
Shadow of the Lone Wolf (Ring)
Grade: F+
+15 points of agility
+10 night vision
Note: You are like a lone wolf in the night, hiding in the darkness and giving the enemy a fatal blow at any time!
Wolf fang shadow suit effects:
(1/2): +20 points of agility
————————
Guan Yu secretly thought that he was lucky and immediately put on the ring. This ring is definitely one of the equipment he needs most now.
As soon as he put on the ring, Guan Yu felt that his surroundings became brighter and his body felt much lighter.
His own agility is 12 points, and adding 15 points of agility is 27 points. This is definitely a perverted attribute.
You must know that his running speed is actually not slow. He also won first or second place in sprint and long-distance running at the school sports meeting. If it were doubled at this time, I am afraid that even the fastest athletes would have to eat dust behind him!
The foreigner is obviously a foreign nationality, and now there is only one target left!
Just in time to test the effect of the Lone Wolf's Shadow, Guan Yu decided to kill those who dared to plot against him.
He passed the two people and was about to go downstairs. Suddenly one of the corpses' cell phone rang. Guan Yu thought for a moment, picked up the phone, and pressed the answer button.
The other person on the phone spoke English and babbled for a while, but then he obviously felt uncomfortable.Satisfied, he kept asking, asking Guan Yu to answer.
"Are you ready to die?" Guan Yu thought for a moment and said in a hoarse voice. Then he threw the phone on the ground and slashed it with a knife. His speed was much faster, and the phone was split in half in an instant.
Just now he heard a name from the foreigner on the other end of the phone, Hagen!
This was the second time Guan Yu heard the name Hagen. The first time was from Zuo Han's mouth. Hagen is a name for a person and an organization!
The Hagen Organization is a criminal organization centered on Hagen. Because it is quite low-key and does things without leakage, it has a certain power in Yanhai City. Although it is not as powerful as the local power, it is not weak either.
Guan Yu didn't know where he had offended the people of the Hagen organization, but since they dared to provoke him, they had to be prepared for retaliation!
At this time, his confidence greatly increased, because he found that his nerve reaction speed was also accelerated, which meant that agility increased the overall agility of the body, not just increasing the speed.
If an average person falls down the stairs, they will definitely roll to the bottom like a gourd because their nerves cannot react quickly enough. And if it's Guan Yu, now he can react in time and make difficult moves to prevent himself from falling.
At the same time, his eyes have also become sharper. For example, ordinary people cannot see the traces of bullets, but at this time, if it is Guan Yu, he can see it and avoid it.
However, there are prerequisites for the bullets he can avoid. For example, if the gun is only fifty meters away from him, that is, when the bullet is fired, if it is more than 70% of the range from him, then he can avoid it. Once it exceeds 70%, he may not be able to avoid it, because the bullet is too close and too fast, and his speed may not be enough.
After going downstairs, Guan Yu first looked around to make sure that no one was going out in the alley. Now his night vision ability is +10, and he can see places that were unclear just now, just like during the day.
However, the night vision ability is +10. Guan Yu is not sure what +10 means. Is this 10 distance, brightness or something else?
Walking out of the alley, Guan Yu put the Tang Dao into his backpack, held the pistol in his hand, and moved forward bit by bit.
He listened carefully to the voice. Although his strength had greatly increased, he was a cautious person and would not be arrogant enough to think that he was invincible.
Suddenly a light shone on the road in front of him, and Guan Yu immediately knew that someone was coming.
